description: Collected Datasets for: Open Data and Data Quality Assurance of European Energy Infrastructure - A Review is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Florian Kotthoff, Jonathan Amme (Oldenburger Institut für Informatik). Accompanying material for the paper: "Open Data and Data Quality Assurance of European Energy Infrastructure - A Review".Collected metadata for 102 open datasets of Energy Infrastructure Data in Europe, covering the sectors electricity, heat, and oil + gas. The metadata fields are the following:Dataset: - title: If there is a name, write it here. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
